name: deployment_log_probe_20261110
comment: LQ-20261107-1794. The operator's deployment log on Releases & schedules: read_deployment_log() serves the
lead-owned DeploymentLog@v1 file. These tests pin the property the operator asked for - VERIFIED only when
the builder recorded VERIFIED, every state copied verbatim and never promoted - plus the caps (newest 200
rows, commits trimmed to subjects) and the rule that every read failure (absent, oversized, unreadable,
foreign schema, no list, unstamped, behind the serving release) is UNAVAILABLE or STALE with a reason, never
an empty all-good log. Fixtures are synthetic: the repository is PUBLIC.
